column1: # Imprinted chromosomes and regions. Factual reference rows, curated by OwnGenome.
# Sole source: embedded by og summary collect at build time. The UPD hint emits region and PMID only;
# maternal_upd and paternal_upd remain reference facts here, never a diagnosis from a ROH match.
# start and end are retained for format compatibility and are empty: the hint is chromosome-wide.
# Mixed iso/heterodisomy may leave the imprinted locus outside the observed homozygous runs.
# Region labels are broad cytobands, not diagnostic locus coordinates or a specialist-reviewed assay.
# Overview: Eggermann et al., Imprinting disorders, Nat Rev Dis Primers 9, 33 (2023).
# Per-row PMIDs support the parent-of-origin reference facts; names and symbols are factual labels.
